_comment: National, non-state-specific official government resources. Verified by fetch/search on 2026-08-30. State-specific resources live in states.json instead, per-state, and are placeholders until reviewed.

national.name: Vote.gov

national.name: USA.gov — Voting and Elections

national.name: U.S. Election Assistance Commission (EAC)
